title: Dribble/Behance Portfolio
content: Apply portfolio aesthetic with creative showcase feel. Large hero images and videos. Case study layouts. Before/after comparisons. Process documentation. Tool and skill badges. Testimonials integration. Contact sections. Grid galleries. Hover effects with info overlays. Smooth page transitions.

variants.simple: Create designer portfolio with large imagery, case studies, and creative layouts.
variants.detailed: Apply portfolio aesthetic with creative showcase feel. Large hero images and videos. Case study layouts. Before/after comparisons. Process documentation. Tool and skill badges. Testimonials integration. Contact sections. Grid galleries. Hover effects with info overlays. Smooth page transitions.
variants.advanced: Apply portfolio aesthetic with creative showcase patterns. Hero: full-viewport image/video with overlay text, scroll indicator. Grid: masonry or uniform grid with project thumbnails, hover reveals title and category. Project card: aspect ratio image, title, category, year, hover zoom and filter. Case study: structured sections (overview, problem, process, solution, results). Large imagery: full-bleed images, before/after sliders, image galleries with lightbox. Process: step documentation with screenshots, annotations, sketches. Metrics: results with large numbers, animated count-up. Skills: icon grid or list with proficiency indicators. Testimonials: quote cards, client logos, recommendations. About: portrait image, bio, downloadable resume. Contact: form or email link, social icons, availability status. Navigation: minimal, logo + project links, fixed on scroll. Transitions: page transitions with shared elements, smooth scrolling. Cursor: custom cursor, magnetic buttons, cursor text on hover. Videos: autoplay loops, click to play with sound. Mobile: adapted layouts, thumb-friendly navigation. Performance: lazy loading images, optimized assets. Filters: project category filters, animated reflow. Footer: copyright, social links, back to top. Dark mode: toggle with system preference detection.

author: Ersin KOÇ
